text: Attempt to provoke a natural exchange refusal through the tools: with a 0.01% (1 bp) slippage bound, the smallest that leaves any room above the touch, scripts/exchange-refusal-via-mcp.mjs made 12 plan_order and 12 place_order calls on SOL over stdio MCP; 12 orders filled (each closed again: 12 closes) and 0 were refused by the exchange. No natural exchange refusal is recorded (evidence/p3-tight-slippage-attempts-journal.jsonl).

Earlier exchange refusal, outside the tools: scripts/exchange-refusal-check.mjs sent one IOC buy 5% under the ask straight through pilot's sender (limit 97.41, ask 102.54); the exchange reverted it as ImmediateOrCancelNoFill, tx 0x44dc12314f770217cad88c6eee8a5d9895abd7aa4185e6ba922536d63415a40d (evidence/p2-exchange-refusal-2026-10-24T02-18-19-265Z.json).

A wrong next step, fixed: the 2026-10-24T02:40:00.158Z cap refusal (0.57 SOL on top of 0.2 held) answered "reduce size to at most 0.04 SOL", a size under the SOL minimum, and the agent's plan for 0.04 SOL was then refused on minQuantity ("plan at least 0.1 SOL"). plan_order now checks the room against the minimum; the same request on the fixed code (2026-10-24T04:09:54.516Z, 0.2 SOL held) answered "no SOL order fits under the cap: the room left is 0.04 SOL, below the SOL minimum 0.1; close_position or a reducing order frees room", and the agent planned nothing.

The liquidation rule did not bind in the runs above: at the default $25 cap this account (about 49.5 USDso) stays under 1x leverage, where the exchange reports no reachable liquidation price for a long. scripts/liquidation-rule-via-mcp.mjs planned SOL longs under a policy file that raises maxNotionalUsd to $1000, every other limit default (minLiquidationDistancePct 15). 1 SOL (2.1199x) planned ok, liquidation 55.56, 45.82% from mark; 2 SOL (4.3428x) planned ok, liquidation 80.95, 21.05% from mark; 3 SOL (6.6763x) refused: liquidation would sit 12.80% from mark, closer than the 15% minimum. Plans only, nothing was sent.
